# The Impostor / El Impostor — The Ultimate Spy Party Game
> Marketing website and official guide for The Impostor mobile social deduction game.

## Overview
The Impostor (El Impostor) is a mobile party and social deduction game where one or more players are secret spies (impostors) trying to blend in while citizen detectives attempt to uncover them.
- Available on: iOS (Apple App Store) and Android (Google Play Store).
- Players: 3 to 20 players in Pass & Play mode; 4 to 8 players in Online Multiplayer.
- Languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese.
- Dual Language Website: Full support for English and Spanish with an interactive language switch.

## Core Features
- **Pass & Play Local Mode**: 1 single smartphone passed around. 100% offline, zero accounts, no internet or Wi-Fi required.
- **Online Multiplayer Rooms**: Play with remote friends across iOS and Android with private 4-letter room codes.
- **1,000+ Curated Words**: Handcrafted secret words across Food, Travel, Everyday Objects, Animals, Pop Culture, and Party themes.
- **Custom Words**: In-app custom word list builder for personalized party inside jokes.
- **Multiple Spies & Timers**: Configurable impostor count and countdown discussion clocks.
